## 📦 What's Included

### 16 AAA-Quality Visual Effects

1. **Atmospheric Scattering** - Realistic sky with Rayleigh/Mie scattering
2. **Volumetric Clouds** - Procedural cloud system with wind/erosion
3. **Ocean Rendering** - FFT-based wave simulation with foam
4. **Volumetric Fog** - Height-based fog with ray marching
5. **God Rays** - Volumetric light shafts
6. **Bloom & Lens Flare** - HDR bloom + lens effects
7. **Screen Space Reflections** - SSR with ray marching
8. **Ambient Occlusion** - SSAO with spiral sampling
9. **Depth of Field** - Bokeh DOF with Circle of Confusion
10. **Motion Blur** - Per-pixel velocity-based blur
11. **Color Grading** - Full color correction pipeline
12. **Chromatic Aberration** - Lens distortion effects
13. **Film Grain** - Procedural grain
14. **Sharpen** - Edge enhancement
15. **Rain Drops** - Screen-space rain effects
16. **Procedural Sky** - Gradient sky with stars

- **2 Actor Files**: UltimateVFX.h + UltimateVFX.cpp
- **48 Shader Files**: 16 shaders × 3 files each (.usf + .h + .cpp)

### Features

- ✅ **Automatic Shader Dispatch** - Actors auto-call shaders in Tick()
- ✅ **Type-Safe Bindings** - FVector3f conversions handled automatically
- ✅ **Network Replication** - Server RPCs for time of day and weather

- ✅ **Zero Manual Edits** - Compiles as-is in UE5

## 🎮 How to Use

### 1. Enable the Plugin
- Open your UE5 project
- Go to Edit > Plugins
- Search for "UltimateVFX"
- Enable the plugin
- Restart the editor

### 2. Add Actors to Your Level
- Drag any of the 16 effect actors into your level
- Configure parameters in the Details panel
- Effects will automatically render

### 3. Control from Blueprints
- Use Server RPCs to change time of day
- Adjust weather states
- Modify effect intensities in real-time
